  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "coa + che + lla; /koʊ/ + /ʃeɪ/ + /lə/ suggests co- + she + la",
    "reading": "A joining with the feminine voice: “with-she,” then a light exclamation, a call into company.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.72
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "coa ~ quau/quoi?; chela ~ chela (Sp. slang) / chela (Hindustani) = beer; together: “what? beer?”",
    "reading": "A puzzled toast: question followed by drink, as if meaning arrives through intoxication.",
    "languages": ["es", "hi", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.41
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "coachella ~ coche + ella; coche (Sp.) = carriage, ella = she",
    "reading": "“Her carriage”: the feminine vehicle, or the soul borne along by its own conveyance.",
    "languages": ["es", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.66
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "ella (Spanish) = she; checkable in Real Academia Española, Diccionario de la lengua española",
    "reading": "The ending names the feminine principle plainly: she, the marked and manifest feminine.",
    "languages": ["es"],
    "source": "Real Academia Española, Diccionario de la lengua española",
    "confidence": 0.88
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "co- (Latin) = with, together; checkable in Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary",
    "reading": "A word of accompaniment: togetherness, conjunction, being-with rather than being-alone.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "Lewis & Short, A Latin Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.79
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "coachella → a call echo",
    "reading": "A call that returns as echo: invocation answered by resonance.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.57
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "C + O + A + C + H + E + L + L + A; C/O as circle, A as apex, H as gate, L as angle",
    "reading": "Circle, opening, ascent, gate, angle: a path from enclosure to threshold to standing form.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.52
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "C-O-A-C-H-E-L-L-A read as initials: Call On A قلب?; the letters invite expansion into a sentence of summons",
    "reading": "An acrostic of summons: call, open, ascend, cross, hear, enter, linger, look, arrive.",
    "languages": ["en", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.28
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "A=1, C=3, E=5, H=8, L=12, O=15; Coachella sums to 61 by simple alphabetic value",
    "reading": "Sixty-one: a number of completion after six tens and one, the one returning after the cycle.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.35
  }
]
